verdict.rationale: HubSpot's marketing page claims revenue-focused multi-touch attribution and customer journey analytics, so attributing revenue to marketing touchpoints is a documented first-party capability. Nothing in the pack shows that attribution resolving to individual emails or automated flows, or covering signups specifically. The email API only references post-send statistics. Missing for 10: documentation of attribution reports at the email and workflow level, signup/conversion attribution per email, attribution model details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can attribute signups or revenue to specific emails and flows, not just opens and clicks

citations.quote: Drive revenue with multi-touch attribution and customer journey analytics that show what's actually working.
See exactly where in the customer journey visitors are ready to convert and place the right touchpoints at the right moments.
Your HubSpot account includes flexible, customizable dashboards that allow you to see campaign performance data in one place
